The Lord stirred the spirit of Cyrus. How does God move even powerful people?
Everyone whose spirit God had stirred went to rebuild. What is God stirring you to do?
Ordinary families returned to rebuild. What does this show about God using everyday people?
The people gave freely for the house of God. How can you give to God's work?
They built the altar first, before the temple. Why put worship first?
They sang, "He is good, for his steadfast love endures forever toward Israel." What are you thankful for?
Some wept and some shouted for joy. How can grief and joy mix as God rebuilds?
Enemies worked to discourage them and frustrate their plans. What discourages you from God's work?
The work stopped. What do you do when God's work seems stalled?
Haggai and Zechariah encouraged them and they began to rebuild. Who encourages you?
"The eye of their God was on the elders." What does it mean that God watches over his people?
They said, "We are the servants of the God of heaven and earth." How would you describe who you serve?
They finished building by the decree of God through the prophets. How does God complete what he begins?
They celebrated the dedication with joy. How do you celebrate what God has done?
The Lord had made them joyful. What has God done to bring you joy?
"The hand of the Lord his God was on him." What does God's hand on your life look like?
Ezra set his heart to study the law, to do it and to teach it. Which of these do you need to grow in?
Ezra blessed God who put it into the king's heart. How do you recognise God's hand in events?
Ezra fasted and prayed for a safe journey instead of asking for soldiers. When do you need to trust God rather than human help?
"The hand of our God was on us, and he delivered us." How has God kept you safe?
Ezra was appalled at the people's unfaithfulness. How do you respond to sin among God's people?
Ezra prayed, "Our guilt has mounted up to the heavens," yet God had shown favour. How does God's grace meet our guilt?
Ezra said, "You, our God, have punished us less than our iniquities deserved." How does this speak to you?
The people wept bitterly and said, "There is hope for Israel." What gives hope in repentance?
"Arise, for it is your task... be strong and do it." What task is God asking you to take up?
The people said, "It is so; we must do as you have said." What does obedience after confession look like?
